notes: Background: B2B product company (product configurator + help center) looking to embed an in-app assistant and improve search relevance across docs and product FAQs.
Prior steps: started on Redwood Hosted API in Q4 2025 for quick evals; moved to Dedicated evaluation after latency and data isolation questions surfaced.
Quote from VP Product: 'We need predictable tail latency and the ability to route to lower-cost variants for bulk queries. Also, no customer data should leave our VPC.'
Cost sensitivity: moderate — unit cost matters but stability + latency are higher priority for product release.
POC ask: Dedicated reserved pool for 2 months, canary route 10% -> 50% -> 100% with automatic rollback, model variant fallback to quantized Llama2-70B-8bit for low-cost bursts.
Security: Strict SSO requirement (SAML + SCIM), SOC2 required for procurement, KMS integration mandatory for key management, 90-day audit log retention requested.
Desired metrics: p50 latency < 150ms for short-chat payloads (<=512 tokens), p95 < 400ms; sustained throughput goal 20-30 reqs/sec for canary; availability SLO 99.9%.
Routing plan: primary NA dedicated cluster (us-west), fallback to EU region dedicated pool if NA capacity constrained; fallback model variant (cost-tier) available for non-critical reranking jobs.
Rollback criteria: error rate > 1.5% above baseline OR p95 latency breach for >5 minutes -> automatic rollback to previous stable model/route.
Open legal: standard MSA counters are with Procurement; procurement needs monthly pricing + overage terms for burst capacity.
SE notes: need sample traffic profile + anonymized prompt set for batching/quantization recommendations. Suggested Optimize run to estimate token cost with batching and KV cache.
Next internal: infra diagram + networking checklist sent to their infra lead (cc: security). Waiting on firewall/NAT details.
Short fragments from calls: 'canary must support canary-by-customer', 'we care about deterministic rollbacks', 'want SLA language for latency'

requirements_summary: Dedicated POC for mid-market SaaS product team: must support canary-by-customer rollout, model-variant fallback, region failover (NA->EU), deterministic rollback automation, SAML + KMS + SOC2 compliance, target p50<150ms and p95<400ms. Provide cost estimates for steady-state and burst scenarios.
po_requested: Yes - procurement requested monthly commit + overage tiers. Need Pricing deck link in Drive.
decision_criteria: Latency + predictable p95, data isolation (VPC + KMS), clear rollback and routing policies, cost estimates within 100-250k ARR band, SLA commitments for dedicated pool.
sales_play_notes: PLG -> AE motion: used Hosted to qualify. Now SE-led Dedicated POC. Emphasize Optimize suggestions (batching + cached prefixes) to reduce token spend during canary. Prepare a short runbook for their infra team documenting egress IPs, peering, and provisioning timeline.
final_comments: Good technical fit; procurement timeline is primary blocker. If POC shows stable p95 and predictable cost, strong chance to convert to annual reserved capacity.
